senses.gloss:
1. लग् लग्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To adhere, Pañc. i. d. 340.
 2. To attach one's self, Pañc. 245, 6.
 3. To stick (in the throat), Śiś. 9, 69.
 4. To pass away, to expire, Pañc. 185, 19.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. लग्न.
 1. Attached, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 13; impressed, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; joined, Hit. 35, 12; following, Pañc. 106, 13; impending, 50, 18.
 2. Left, Śāk. d. 32.
 3. Intent on, occupied, being about, Pañc. 244, 6.
 4. Auspicious, Hit. 89, 8, M.M. m. A bard. n.
 1. The rising of a sign, its appearance above the horizon, Lass. 24, 8.
 2. Auspicious time, Hit. 97, 13; cf. 94, 9.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, अनुलग्न, Following, Lass. 30, 10.
 --With अव अव, अवलग्न, []
 1. Attached.
 2. m. and n. The waist, Śiś. 9, 49.
 --With वि वि, विलग्न,
 1. Joined, attached, Śiś. 9, 20; clinging to, ib. 84; Pañc. 259, 2 (तत्रैव विलग्नः, Took hold of it).
 2. Touching, Pañc. 186, 9.
 3. Tarried, Pañc. 207, 22. n. The waist.
 --With सम् सम्, संलग्न, Joined, adhering.
 --Cf. perhaps λήγω (but cf. लञ्ज and लङ्गूल).

लगुड लगुड, m.
 1. A stick, a staff, Hit. 51, 6, M.M.
 2. An iron club, a club, Hit. 101, 12.
लग्नक लग्न + क (vb. लग्), m. A surety.
लागुडिक लागुडिक, i. e. लगुड + इक, m. One who bears a club, a sentinel, Pañc. 230, 19.
लग्न- + समय लग्न- + समय, m. auspicious time, Pañc. 129, 16.
